note: The portfolio. tools/build_work.py renders this into docs/index.html between the WORK markers. Counts are fetched at build time; stated numbers are verified against the live page before they ship.

lanes.name: The platforms
lanes.head: Eight platforms, each at its own address
lanes.sub: Every frame is a screenshot of the production page, taken for this build. Click through — they are all open.

lanes.name: The directories
lanes.head: Directories built on the same bench
lanes.sub: One toolchain: harvest, cite, publish a map, an API and a plain-text copy for machines. Point it at a new subject and a directory comes out.

lanes.name: The apps
lanes.head: Apps that install from a link
lanes.sub: Open the address on a phone, add it to the home screen, and it runs from there like anything else on it.

lanes.name: The instruments
lanes.th: เครื่องมือ
lanes.head: Working instruments, procedurally drawn
lanes.sub: Astronomical and ritual instruments — every dial, hand and grain of gold drawn live in the browser, no libraries.

lanes.name: The explainers
lanes.head: Six explainers, drawn from the equations
lanes.sub: Physics and mathematics in plain words, with the pictures and figures computed on the page from the formula shown.

lanes.name: The record
lanes.head: What the work is measured against
lanes.sub: The count of everything held, the traffic study behind how it is published, and the page that says who runs the directory.

cards.name: Mot Dang
cards.th: มดแดง · สารบัญเมืองเชียงใหม่–เชียงราย
cards.body: A Thai-first city directory for Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai — places, hours, phones, pins, shelves and answer pages. The crawlers run every morning and the page says where each field came from.

also.text: เชียงใหม่ · Chiang Mai
เชียงราย · Chiang Rai

cards.name: wichaa
cards.th: วิชา · หอความรู้ล้านนาที่ยังมีชีวิต
cards.body: Lanna manuscripts from the northern libraries, with their page images, read in three scripts — palm leaf carried to a phone screen. The amulet market, the temple atlas and the instruments below all live inside it.

also.text: the temple atlas of the Lanna north

cards.name: Defiant
cards.th: คู่มือผู้ป่วยข้ามพรมแดน
cards.body: Medical and dental care in Chiang Mai with the price posted before you commit, a professional translator at the appointment, and a flat concierge fee that does not scale with the bill.

cards.name: Hak Farang
cards.th: ฮักฝรั่ง · พี่สาวที่ผ่านมาก่อน
cards.body: Money, visas, travel and life with a farang partner, written in Thai for the women living it — by the older sister who went first.

cards.name: Offrampt
cards.th: เปลี่ยนคริปโตเป็นเงินใช้ในไทย
cards.body: Turning crypto into spendable local money without a local bank account. Thailand first: the routes, the cards, the fees, and what each one costs to use.

cards.name: Poplucky
cards.th: ป๊อปลัคกี้ · สารบบกล่องสุ่ม
cards.body: Every blind box, catalogued in the words collectors use — characters, series, and what a shelf is missing.

cards.name: The portal
cards.th: ประตูรวมทุกงาน
cards.body: One door onto the whole constellation — platforms, directories, apps and instruments, on a page drawn fresh each visit.

cards.name: Chiang Mai Visa Desk
cards.th: ใบอนุญาตทำงาน จดทะเบียนบริษัท และวีซ่า
cards.body: A visa and work-permit desk for Chiang Mai, in English and Thai: work permits, Thai company registration, retirement extensions, 90-day reports and escorted border runs, each quoted in writing. A second book prepares US visa files for Thai nationals, and the site licenses to agencies in other provinces.

cards.name: Amulet Atlas
cards.th: แผนที่เครื่องรางทั่วโลก
cards.body: Amulets, charms and talismans worldwide, by tradition and by place — from the Girsu foundation pegs of about 2130 BCE forward. The global companion to the Thai catalogue.

cards.name: Care Abroad
cards.th: รักษาข้ามพรมแดน · ราคาที่ประกาศไว้
cards.body: Who goes where for treatment, what it costs, what the law says, and who checked. A price carries the date it was published; a legality reading carries its statute.

cards.name: The Mae Hong Son Loop
cards.th: วงรอบแม่ฮ่องสอน
cards.body: 600 km of mountain road out of Chiang Mai, with the curves counted off the geometry rather than repeated from a brochure — and everything worth stopping for along the way.

also.text: the same guide, in Thai, on Mot Dang

cards.name: Hand Poke
cards.th: สักด้วยมือ
cards.body: Traditions of marking skin by hand: who is marked, who does the marking, and where on the body. Five sources put the leg tattoo of Burma, the Shan States and Lanna in the same zone — and none of them had read the others.

also.text: the leg-tattoo zone, counted, on wichaa

cards.name: Muay Thai
cards.th: มวยไทย · แปดอาวุธ
cards.body: The eight limbs, the thirty named techniques, and the gyms that teach them — with the Lanna root of the art and the sak yant that came with it kept in the frame.

cards.name: Carolina Barbecue
cards.th: บาร์บีคิวแคโรไลนา
cards.body: Wood, sauce and pig across North and South Carolina, pit by pit — a tag carries the source it was read from.

cards.name: Wing Country
cards.th: ปีกไก่อเมริกัน
cards.body: Thirteen American cities argue about a chicken wing. An Albers map of all fifty states, the sauces read off the panel, and a claim carries the name it came from.

also.text: build a sauce, a rub or a dip from a cited recipe

cards.name: Pink Box
cards.th: โดนัทร้านเล็กทั่วอเมริกา
cards.body: The American mom-and-pop donut shop — cake against raised, what else is in the case, and the chains told apart from the independents. The counts page shows the split.

cards.name: Pinot Country
cards.th: ไร่องุ่นปีโนต์นัวร์
cards.body: One thin-skinned grape, the ground it answers to, and the cellars that work it — with every AVA boundary date read off 27 CFR part 9 rather than a wine list.

cards.name: Basque Tables
cards.th: โต๊ะอาหารบาสก์
cards.body: The Basque dining rooms of California, Nevada and Idaho — where the house sits you, what dinner runs to, which nights the door opens, and whether the bar makes a Picon. In English and Basque.

cards.name: Amulet Essentials
cards.th: สารบบเครื่องราง
cards.body: The kinds of sacred object, as data — each with the market listings behind it, a price chart, and pictures anyone may reuse.

cards.name: Roads of Chiang Mai
cards.th: ถนนเชียงใหม่
cards.body: The square of 1296, four rings around it and the roads between, and what each one did to the city. Counted from the map, dated from the record.

cards.name: Ghost Chiang Mai
cards.th: ผีเจียงใหม่
cards.body: A self-guided tour of the city's dead, on foot, by bicycle, by scooter or with a driver: a ghost story at each stop and the merit act that goes with it.

cards.name: Pike Place Market
cards.th: ตลาดไพค์เพลส · ซีแอตเทิล
cards.body: Every licensed business inside Seattle's Pike Place Market Historical District, the date each started trading, and a map drawn from open data.

cards.name: Scanner
cards.th: เครื่องสแกนในเบราว์เซอร์
cards.body: Photograph a page; it finds the sheet, straightens it, flattens the light so the paper reads white, and writes a PDF. Sign with a finger on the glass — a saved signature is encrypted under a PIN, or under the fingerprint sensor where the phone offers it.

cards.name: Ask Mot Dang
cards.th: คุยกับมด
cards.body: A reader's assistant sitting on the city directory. Ask in Thai or English — it answers from the directory's own pages and links the one it used.

facts.text: links the page it answered from

cards.name: White-label assistants
cards.th: ผู้ช่วยติดแบรนด์ รายที่นั่ง
cards.body: The same assistant, rebuilt as a product: one tenant, its own corpus, its own front door, sold by the seat. Ask Mot Dang is tenant number one.

cards.name: The send page
cards.th: ส่งเมลจากมือถือ
cards.body: Four people send mail from their own address on a phone, without a mail client. The passphrase is the identity.

cards.name: Thai Roots
cards.th: รากศัพท์
cards.body: A Thai dictionary read by root, in the Hans Wehr manner — Pali and Sanskrit roots, native morpheme families, sound-change keys and a decomposer that takes a word apart. The whole dictionary is on the phone.

cards.name: Sam Ching
cards.th: สามชิ่ง · บิลเลียดสามคูชั่น
cards.body: Three-cushion billiards on a phone: drag anywhere to aim, release to shoot, and the cloth carries the physics rather than a scoreboard.

cards.name: Skip DJT
cards.th: เทียบค่าตั๋วสามสนามบิน
cards.body: Palm Beach airport took a president's name. This compares the same-day fare out of Palm Beach, Fort Lauderdale and Miami, and shows what the drive south saves.

cards.name: FarangBuddy
cards.th: ตัวนับวันพำนักในไทย
cards.body: A Thailand stay tracker. Entries, exits, border runs and extensions go in; the admitted-until date and the next 90-day report and TM30 come out. More than one person per phone.

cards.name: The Jovilabe
cards.th: เครื่องดูดวงจันทร์บริวารดาวพฤหัส
cards.body: Jupiter's four great moons, where they stand tonight and where their shadows fall.

cards.name: The moon complication
cards.th: หน้าปัดข้างขึ้นข้างแรม
cards.body: One dial, two moons, and what it takes to get it right.

cards.name: The Red Spot dial
cards.th: หน้าปัดจุดแดงใหญ่
cards.body: When the Great Red Spot faces someone standing in the storm — from a Jovian horizon.

cards.name: Divination
cards.th: เครื่องเสี่ยงทายตามตำรา
cards.body: I Ching, Plum Blossom and Wen Wang Gua on one engine, showing its working rather than hiding it.

cards.name: Hun Payont
cards.th: หุ่นพยนต์ · หุ่นที่ปลุกด้วยวิชา
cards.body: An effigy you forge, carrying your name to the market each morning and bringing one thing back.

cards.name: Waikhru Yon
cards.th: ไหว้ครูยนต์ · พรสำหรับมือที่จับเครื่อง
cards.body: The mark a craftsperson paints on a machine, and the blessing that goes with the hand at the lathe.

cards.name: I'm holding an amulet
cards.th: ถืออยู่ในมือ · ประตูจำแนกพระเครื่อง
cards.body: You have the thing but not its name. Answer the questions a dealer would ask, in the dealer's order.

cards.name: The kesa yant
cards.th: ยันต์เกศาผิด
cards.body: The thirty-two parts of the body as thirty-two letters, laid in by the knight's move. The method traced through the manuals in the corpus, and whether the loop closes.

cards.name: Black Holes, Drawn
cards.th: หลุมดำ วาดจากสมการ
cards.body: Black holes modelled and drawn from the equations: generators you can run, the past, the present and the far future, and the legends that got there first.

cards.name: Quantum Computing, plainly
cards.th: คอมพิวเตอร์ควอนตัม
cards.body: Qubits, interference, entanglement, Shor, Grover, error correction and the machines, in plain words.

cards.name: The Three-Body Problem
cards.th: ปัญหาสามวัตถุ
cards.body: Gravity, the two-body solution, why three has no formula, chaos, Lagrange points and the figure-eight orbit, computed on the page.

cards.name: Exceptional Magic
cards.th: ออกโทเนียน · E8
cards.body: Eight ways to multiply and where they lead: the octonions, triality, the magic square and E8, drawn from the arithmetic.

cards.name: Big Numbers, Split
cards.th: การแยกตัวประกอบ
cards.body: Factoring from Eratosthenes to Shor: how big numbers get split, who has split the biggest, and what it means for a bitcoin wallet.

cards.name: Goin' Fast
cards.th: ความเร็ว
cards.body: Twenty measured speeds from continental drift to light, the three things that make going fast cost, and four calculators.

cards.name: The index
cards.th: สารบัญของทั้งหมด
cards.body: Everything held, counted once, at one address — a number names the file, database or endpoint it was read from, and the day it was read.

cards.name: Uptake
cards.th: คู่มือ — เขียนให้เครื่องอ่าน
cards.body: Fourteen days across fifty-two repositories: 961 clones from 501 distinct machines against 36 page views from 20 browsers. The manual written on that measurement — the arrival worth designing for is the copy, not the click.

cards.name: Who keeps the ants
cards.th: ใครเลี้ยงมด
cards.body: The page on the city directory that names the person behind it, the machines that run the crawls, and the address to write to about a mistake.

workshop.head: And the workshop behind it
workshop.th: และโรงงานเบื้องหลัง
workshop.sub: The addresses above stand on a bench of smaller tools — written, used daily, and kept running. A sampling:
workshop.note: Source code moves between forges as platforms come and go. Ask for the current mirror of anything here; the live addresses above are the ones to bookmark.
